caption:
Lodged in October and just remembered a deduction? You can still fix it.

Most people have 2 years to amend a return, counted from the day after their notice of assessment is sent. Wait until your original return is processed, then in myGov go to ATO, Manage tax returns, and choose Amend for that year (or ask a registered tax agent). Online amendments take about 15 business days; paper ones up to 90.

Only add what you have records for.

Save this for later.

General info only, not personal advice.

#taxreturn #taxtips #australiantax #mygov #moneytips
figures_checked: Amendment time limit: generally 2 years from day after notice of assessment sent (ATO Time limits on amendments, checked 1 Nov 2026)

How to amend: myGov > ATO > Manage tax returns > Amend; wait until original processed; online ~15 business days, written up to 90 (ATO How to request an amendment, updated 28 Oct 2026, checked 1 Nov 2026)
